jordan: folks — quick shout: midnight deploy finished, metrics look clean. we just crossed 2,000,000 monthly requests 🎉

rachel: WHAT 😭👏👏👏

devon: 🤯 amazing!!! snacks? neon stickers? team karaoke? :neon:

mike: neon stickers pls. also: latency p50 down ~24% since the kernel tweak — big win for infra team

elaine: can we do a tiny 🍾 in the kitchen tomorrow? (and water the office plants?)

deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-api v1.14.2 succeeded — no errors in last 30m (CI: #3345)

jordan: mini poll: stickers, boba, or sourdough? react with :sticker: :bubble_tea: :bread:

rachel: picked :sticker: — i'll bring tape

devon: :bubble_tea: for me

mike: :bread: anyone want salty or sweet?

elaine: salty. also can ops get a round of kudos? huge props to @mike @devon for the kernel patch

mike: thanks! couldn't have done it without @elaine's perf tests

rachel: can we take a photo for the #wins board? shelfie + stickers + one small gong?

jordan: yes! i'll grab the mini gong. midnight crew — virtual high five :raised_hands:

devon: :raised_hands: :sparkles:
